note: Remote MCP endpoints use OAuth; each user signs in with their own account via /mcp. Endpoints taken from Anthropic's published plugins (Oct 2026) — re-check when a vendor announces a new version.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.notes: Slack's MCP server requires a registered OAuth app. Connect Slack in claude.ai → Settings → Connectors; Claude Code uses claude.ai connectors when you are signed in with the same account.

connectors.name: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Excel)
connectors.notes: Use the Microsoft 365 connector in claude.ai if your plan and tenant allow it. Microsoft Project and Planner: export to Excel/CSV and use /pmo:import.

connectors.name: Google Drive / Sheets
connectors.notes: Connect Google Drive in claude.ai → Settings → Connectors, or download the sheet as .xlsx/.csv and use /pmo:import.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.notes: Connect Gmail in claude.ai → Settings → Connectors.

connectors.name: Microsoft Project / Planner
connectors.notes: File → Save As/Export → Excel or CSV (ID, Name, Duration, Predecessors, % Complete, Start, Finish), then /pmo:import --type schedule or --type progress.
